entities.summary: Leif Carlsson is a Swedish former professional ice hockey defenceman. Until November 2021 he was the head coach of EV Landshut of the DEL2. Carlsson was selected by the Hartford Whalers in the 3rd round of the 1983 NHL Entry Draft.
